scene_description: A family of four is camping in the woods. Two adults and two children sit around a round fire pit with a campfire burning. They appear to be roasting marshmallows on sticks. A green tent and blue camping chairs are visible in the background, surrounded by tall trees.

questions.question: What do you see in this picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the middle of the picture — what is burning there?

questions.question: What are the kids doing with their sticks?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the sticks the children are holding near the fire.

questions.question: Where are the people sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees and ground around the people.

questions.question: What is the tent for?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the green tent behind the people — think about what people do inside a tent.

questions.question: What might happen next after the marshmallows are done cooking?
sample_answers: they take them off the stick
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the marshmallows on the sticks over the fire — what do people do after they cook food?

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever eaten a marshmallow? What did it taste like?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you ate something sweet and soft.
